title: Blue Mountain - That's What Sea Said | Vacation Rental Management
description_expanded:
Blue Mountain Beach

695 steps (.3 miles) to Blue Mountain Regional Beach Access

Private rooftop terrace!

Community pool. Heated!

Charming interiors, a second living area!

Community grill

3 bikes!

5-star restaurants

Fun and yummy shops

That's What Sea Said by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to That’s What Sea Said, where there’s plenty of room to spread out, gather back up, and find your favorite spot somewhere in between. The community pool and grilling area are definite crowd-pleasers, but that third-floor deck has a pretty strong following of its own. After the pool, hop on a complimentary beach cruiser and explore the delightful community of Blue Mountain Beach. You and your crew will love the great restaurants and yummy eateries. Make sure to visit Blue Mountain Creamery for the best local ice cream. Inside, the first floor keeps things comfortable with a spacious living room and plenty of seating.

There’s also a guest room with a queen bed, which features an added seating area and a mini fridge. Upstairs, the fully stocked kitchen is ready for everything from quick snacks to dinner for the whole group. The dining table seats six, with four more spots at the bar. A second living area nearby gives everyone another place to settle in for a movie, game, or some well-earned doing absolutely nothing. Also on the second floor is a bedroom made for the younger crowd, with two full beds and two twins above. A hall bathroom is conveniently close. The third floor brings a primary bedroom with a king bed and private bath, plus a guest room with two queen beds and its own private bath. Then comes the fun part: a spiral staircase leads up to the deck. Head up, take in the views, and congratulate yourself on claiming the best seat in the house. And when the deck finally loses you to the pool, the community swimming and grilling area is ready for round two. Oversee 30A is locally based and close by when you need us. Our team is available seven days a week, with a 24/7 emergency line for anything that can’t wait. Come enjoy That’s What Sea Said. We have a feeling you’ll have plenty of nice things to say, too. Overview: - 695 steps (.3 miles) to the beach (Blue Mountain Regional Access) - 4 bedrooms, 4 baths - 2464 sq ft - Community grill - Heated community pool - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Parking limited to two vehicles Overnight: FIRST FLOOR - Guest Room: queen bed, shared bath, additional seating area SECOND FLOOR - Guest Room: two full beds, and two twins above, shared bath THIRD FLOOR - Primary Bedroom: king bed, private bath - Guest Room: two queen beds, private bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
